legal_ref: Momsloven, LBK nr. 209 af 27/02/2024 (as amended), § 33, stk. 1
quote: Afgiften udgør 25 pct. af afgiftsgrundlaget. — The tax is 25% of the taxable amount.
source_title: Retsinformation — Bekendtgørelse af lov om merværdiafgift (momsloven), LBK nr. 209 af 27/02/2024 (status: gældende)

reduced_rates.scope: zero rate (exempt with deduction): newspapers; domestic passenger air transport (amending law of 2024-12-30); exports and intra-EU supplies. No positive reduced rates

notes: Denmark applies a single 25% rate. Faroe Islands and Greenland are outside Danish VAT. Zero VAT on books was agreed in the Finance Act 2026 deal (planned 2026-07-01, bill L 125) but no enacting law appears in the list of amendments to LBK 209/2024 on Retsinformation as of Oct 2026; reportedly withdrawn and awaiting reintroduction. TEDB cross-check: 25% standard, no reduced rates — consistent.
unverified: valid_from 1992-01-01 (increase from 22% to 25%) not confirmed in an official text
status of zero-rating of books (bill L 125, 2025-26) seen only in secondary sources
zero-rating scope (newspapers, air passenger transport) taken from Retsinformation amendment titles/TEDB, provisions not read individually
